name: What are common elements or design trends seen in luxury floor plans in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What are common elements or design trends seen in luxury floor plans in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: In South Florida, luxury floor plans frequently incorporate open-concept living areas that flow into outdoor spaces, often featuring large sliding glass doors to maximize natural light and views. Smart home technology integration, dedicated home offices, and multi-generational suites are also prevalent. Wet bars, wine cellars, and expansive master suites with walk-in closets are common as well. Buyers should consider how these elements align with their personal use and future needs, as design trends evolve and may impact long-term value and personal enjoyment.
acceptedAnswer.description: South Florida luxury floor plans emphasize open concepts, indoor-outdoor living, smart home tech, and specialized rooms like home offices or multi-generational suites.
